```yaml
name: Test Count

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test-count:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest

    - name: Run test count script
      id: test_count
      run: |
        echo "Counting tests..."
        python - <<EOF > test-stats.json
import re
import json
from pathlib import Path

def count_tests(file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    test_functions = re.findall(r'def test_\w+\(self\):', content)
    return len(test_functions)

total_tests = 0
test_files = list(Path('tests').rglob('*.py'))
for file in test_files:
    total_tests += count_tests(file)

print(json.dumps({'total_tests': total_tests}))
EOF

    - name: Generate badge
      id: generate_badge
      run: |
        echo "Generating badge..."
        curl -s https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-${{ steps.test_count.outputs.total_tests }}-blue.svg -o tests-badge.svg

    - name: Commit and push badge
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add tests-badge.svg
        git commit -m "Add test count badge"
        git push origin main
```
